mapper.select: WITH COMMU_BOARD_VIEW AS ( SELECT COMMU_POST_NO , AVATAR_ID , COMMU_TITLE , COMMU_CONTENTS , CATEGORY_CODE , COMMU_WRITE_DATE , COMMU_POST_HIT , COMMU_POST_STATUS , COMMU_DELETE_DATE FROM COMMU_BOARD NATURAL JOIN AVATAR WHERE COMMU_POST_NO = 'CMBD000001' ) SELECT COMMU_BOARD_VIEW.* , COMMU_COMMENT_CONTENT , COMMU_COMMENT_WRITE_DATE , COMMU_COMMENT_STATUS , COMMU_COMMENT_DELETE_DATE FROM COMMU_BOARD_VIEW LEFT OUTER JOIN COMMU_COMMENT ON (COMMU_BOARD_VIEW.COMMU_POST_NO = COMMU_COMMENT.COMMU_POST_NO)
